releases.body:
Core

Improvements


Upgraded the bundled Bun runtime to 1.4.4, which includes security fixes for Brotli, TLS, HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, WebSocket, and fetch, and updates root certificates to NSS 3.131.1.

Core

Bugfixes


Failed TUI worker requests now return an error instead of leaving the caller hanging. (@Nowaker)


Thank you to 1 community contributor:


@Nowaker:


fix(opencode): answer a failed TUI worker request instead of hanging (#54936)
